'''July 2001 Vancouver tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Hypelight, Vancouver, BC on 22 July 2001. Alex won it. It is known from Cole Roche's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2696">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-23-vancouver-b-c-7-22-01d2696/ vancouver-b-c-7-22-01], DeckTech (Cole "Rabid Wookie" Roche, 23 July 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-23-vancouver-b-c-7-22-01d2696/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 22 July 2001
* '''Site:''' Hypelight, Vancouver, BC
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Tatooine]]
* '''Players:''' 13
* '''Winner:''' Alex
